name: Mr. Massagy
source:
Everybody is someone like Johnny deep inside! So walk on his shoes and get back into the speed-dating game.

Use your Linger app to choose from 9 elegible bachelorettes and get the ultimate reward: A well-earned controller rumble massage.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/511350/Mr_Massagy//]Steam[/url]]
translation:
每个人内心深处都是像约翰尼一样的人！因此，穿上他的鞋子，重新回到快速约会游戏中。

使用你的Linger应用程序从9位优雅的单身女郎中进行选择，并获得终极奖励：一次应得的控制器隆隆按摩。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/511350/Mr_Massagy//]Steam[/url]]
